name: qminiwasm-autolearn
description: AutoLearn MCP server for self-improving AI agents - converts reasoning traces to deterministic code and manages skill libraries

tools.name: capture_reasoning_trace
tools.description: Capture AI agent reasoning steps for crystallization into deterministic code

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent whose reasoning to capture

task_description.description: Description of the task being performed

reasoning_steps.description: Array of reasoning steps with thoughts, actions, and results

context.description: Additional context for the reasoning trace

tools.name: crystallize_skill
tools.description: Convert a captured reasoning trace into a deterministic, reusable skill

trace_id.description: ID of the reasoning trace to crystallize

target_agent.description: Agent to receive the crystallized skill

validation_required.description: Whether to validate the skill before adding to library

tools.name: evaluate_agent_performance
tools.description: Evaluate an AI agent's performance against defined metrics

agent_name.description: Name of the agent to evaluate

include_history.description: Whether to include historical performance data

tools.name: detect_improvement_opportunity
tools.description: Analyze agent performance to detect improvement opportunities

agent_name.description: Name of the agent to analyze

focus_areas.description: Specific areas to focus analysis on

tools.name: generate_improvement_plan
tools.description: Generate an improvement plan for an AI agent based on detected opportunities

agent_name.description: Name of the agent to improve

improvement_opportunity_id.description: ID of the detected improvement opportunity

tools.name: spread_improvement
tools.description: Spread a validated improvement across all relevant AI agents

improvement_id.description: ID of the validated improvement to spread

target_agents.description: Specific agents to spread to (empty = all applicable)

validation_required.description: Whether to validate on each target agent

tools.name: get_skill_library
tools.description: Retrieve the current skill library for an agent or all agents

agent_name.description: Name of the agent (empty for all agents)

tools.name: update_managed_memory
tools.description: Update the managed memory/context for an agent's learning

resources.name: metrics_config
resources.description: Discrete metrics configuration for all agents

resources.name: skill_libraries
resources.description: Accumulated skill libraries from all agents

resources.name: improvement_history
resources.description: History of all improvements and their spread

prompts.name: improvement_analysis
prompts.description: Prompt template for analyzing improvement opportunities
prompts.template: Analyze the performance of {{agent_name}} agent. Current metrics: {{metrics}}. Historical trend: {{trend}}. Identify specific improvement opportunities and their potential impact.

prompts.name: skill_crystallization
prompts.description: Prompt template for crystallizing reasoning into skills
prompts.template: Convert the following reasoning trace into a deterministic, reusable skill for {{target_agent}}. Trace: {{trace}}. Ensure the skill is testable, measurable, and can be validated automatically.

prompts.name: cross_agent_spread
prompts.description: Prompt template for spreading improvements across agents
prompts.template: The improvement {{improvement_description}} was validated in {{source_agent}}. Determine which other agents ({{target_agents}}) can benefit from this improvement and how to adapt it for each.
